description: This file implements the SystemInfo class and related nested classes for gathering and managing system information such as network, security, location, device ID, time, and software version within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It includes methods for registration, updating, and retrieving system data, as well as handling notifications to registered clients.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Main class providing system information management, including registration of notifications, updating data, and access to nested information classes.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Internet
classes.description: Handles network-related information such as public IP address and network type.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Security
classes.description: Provides security-related information such as callsign.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Location
classes.description: Contains location data including timezone, country, region, city, latitude, and longitude.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Id
classes.description: Represents device identification details such as identifier, architecture, chipset, and firmware version.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Register
methods.description: Registers a notification client to receive system updates.

methods.name: SystemInfo::RawDeviceId
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of a network interface, or the first available MAC address if no interface name is provided.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Update
methods.description: Triggers an update of system information and notifies registered clients.

methods.name: SystemInfo::RecursiveList
methods.description: Recursively calls the Updated method on notification clients.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Internet::PublicIPAddress
methods.description: Returns the current public IP address.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Internet::NetworkType
methods.description: Returns the network type (IPv4, IPv6, or unknown).
